extraction.Name: Ruth Josephine Smith (Point At Him)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded July 22, 1920 by C. L. Dice
extraction.Buyer: Conveyed by deed to William H. Tackett for $3100.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739618 issued; southeast quarter of section 5, township 38, range 27; receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 2, 1920; deed conveying land signed by Ruth Point at Him (formerly Ruth Josephine Smith) to William H. Tackett on July 17, 1920
